adjudication.rationale: In `Admin::GroupsController#add_members` and `#remove_member`, the code mutates membership via `group.add(user)` / `group.users.delete(user_id)` before calling `group.save` and branching on success vs `render_json_error` (422). Association changes to the join table are typically persisted at the time of `add`/`delete`, so the subsequent `group.save` is not a reliable “commit membership changes” gate; if `group.save` were to fail validations, the controller could report an error even though membership changes already happened. The diff also shows prior logic (`update_patch`) performed `group.add/remove` without any `group.save`, supporting the idea that the save/error branch here is largely redundant.
